events.title: Fading Echo Update - Hotfix V.1.0.27953
events.author: nt_arrowhead
events.body: Hello Legends! First of all, the entire team would like to thank you for the incredible welcome you've given Fading Echo. Your support means the world to us! We've been carefully reading all of your feedback-both the kind words (thank you ) and your suggestions for improvement. Every comment helps us make the game even better!  Today, we're deploying our first hotfix, which includes:[*]Updated localization for Japanese, Korean, Simplified Chinese, and Traditional Chinese, including character customization.[/*][*]Fixed an issue where XP could disappear after dying during the final battles.[/*][*]Fixed an issue where dying to Corruption during the final battles could send players back to the main menu.[/*]  Please keep sharing your feedback with us! We're listening, and we'll continue improving the game with your help  Feel free to join our Discord to chat with other players, as well as the game's developers: https://discord.com/invite/fadingechogame ("https://discord.com/invite/fadingechogame")  Have a wonderful journey through the Echoverse! – The Fading Echo Team

events.title: Fading Echo is OUT NOW!
events.author: Galathée
events.body:
Step into Fading Echo, a fast-paced elemental action-adventure RPG. Developed by an independent French studio, you'll unleash spectacular elemental abilities, meet unforgettable characters, and explore the scorched floating isles and shattered dimensions of Corel.Play as One, a young Legend with a tangled past and precious little time left to save her world. The Paradox Corruption is spreading, reality is collapsing, and Corel is slowly disappearing. Master powerful Ætheric abilities, transform water into a devastating weapon, and slide, shift, and smash your way through breathtaking environments in an epic quest to stop the world's decay.🎙️ An unforgettable adventure deserves an unforgettable cast!
Samantha Béart stars as One, joined by an incredible lineup featuring Jasmine Bhullar, Laura Bailey, Liam O'Brien, Sam Riegel, and Matt Mercer, who delivers a chilling performance as the game's main antagonist.🎮 Console releases are planned for later this year.See you soon in Corel!💬 Don’t forget to join us on Discord ("https://discord.gg/fadingechogame") to share your thoughts & feedbacks!- The Fading Echo Team🌊 Flow with us✨ Buy Fading Echo ("https://store.steampowered.com/app/2467880/Fading_Echo/?snr=1_5_9_")And follow the adventure:YouTube ("http://www.youtube.com/@FadingEchoGame?sub_confirmation=1") | TikTok ("https://www.tiktok.com/@fadingechogame") | Instagram ("https://www.instagram.com/fadingechogame/")

Cayrn Sandh: The Last Idealist
events.author: Galathée
events.body: Some heroes fight because they believe they can change the world. Others fight because they know they probably can't.Cayrn Sandh belongs firmly in the second category. An emissary from Echo, leader of the notorious 5 Ghosts, and one of the most accomplished operatives in the Echoverse, Cayrn has spent centuries navigating impossible missions, impossible choices, and the consequences that inevitably follow both. He's not the kind of man who talks about hope, but the kind who keeps moving long after everyone else has run out of it. Who is Cayrn?There was a time when Cayrn Sandh seemed destined for greatness. Born with the blood of the Ancients and gifted with remarkable talent, he rose through the ranks of the Imperial Guild and appeared poised for a brilliant future. But life had other plans. A series of betrayals, political conflicts, and deeply personal losses pushed him away from the path he had imagined for himself. The promising young prodigy became something else entirely: a field operative trusted with missions few others could survive and burdens few others could carry. Centuries later, that reputation remains intact, if a situation is impossible, chances are Cayrn is already on his way.Whether he wants to be there or not. The Leader of the 5 GhostsAcross the Echoverse, few names command as much respect or fear as the 5 Ghosts. Operating under the Guild of Whispers, Echo's intelligence and covert operations service, the Ghosts are deployed where diplomacy fails and open warfare isn't an option.Assassinations, infiltrations, reconnaissance, extraction missions: if a problem requires deniable specialists capable of crossing realities, the Guild sends the Ghosts. And Cayrn leads them.When Fading Echo begins, Cayrn has only recently returned from a disastrous operation that left several members of the Ghosts missing beyond known Pathways. Their fate remains unknown, and the failure weighs heavily on him, even if he'd never admit it. Instead of being granted time to organize a rescue mission, he's immediately dispatched to Corel.Needless to say, he's not thrilled about the assignment. A Man Between WorldsOfficially, Cayrn's mission is straightforward: locate the last surviving heir of House Kelevra. A century ago, the heir to one of the most influential founding houses in the Thousand Shards Imperium was sent to Corel shortly before the Cataclysm and the closure of the Maze. Now, with the Maze reopened and the Duke of House Kelevra recently deceased, old questions have suddenly become urgent political concerns. Without a legitimate successor, the future of the House and the influence it commands throughout the Legends political landscape hangs in the balance. So Echo sends Cayrn to investigate: Find the heir. Worst case, confirm their fate. Close the case. Simple, at least on paper. Corel, however, is far from simple. What begins as a routine investigation quickly unravels into something far more complicated. The heir Cayrn was sent to find is not the person he expected, and the answers waiting for him on Corel raise more questions than they resolve. Instead of closing a chapter, he finds himself caught in the middle of a family legacy thought buried for a century, with both Rahne and One Kelevra standing at its center. Suddenly, this isn't just another assignment. It's a political powder keg, a personal reckoning, and exactly the kind of complication Cayrn was hoping to avoid. Charm, Cynicism, and SurvivalIf you've met Cayrn, you'll quickly notice two things.[*]First, he's usually the funniest person in the room.[/*][*]Second, that humor is doing a tremendous amount of heavy lifting.[/*] Years of war, loss, impossible responsibilities, and more than a few regrets have left him with a dry wit and a tendency to downplay even the most catastrophic situations. It's a coping mechanism, a defense strategy, and occasionally a source of genuine wisdom. Beneath the sarcasm lies a man who understands people remarkably well and who has spent centuries pretending not to care because caring has always come with a cost. The problem is that no matter how hard he tries, he never quite succeeds. The Warrior Behind the SmileFor all his charm, Cayrn remains one of the most dangerous individuals in the Echoverse. A master of Pathways, Kinæthery, and Metamorphosis, he moves through realities with an ease few can match. His training allows him to manipulate Æther, traverse worlds, alter both body and mind, and adapt to situations that would overwhelm most Legends. Yet his greatest strength isn't supernatural, it's experience. Cayrn has survived long enough to understand that victory is rarely clean and that doing the right thing often comes at a terrible cost.Which is precisely why he's willing to make choices others won't. Even when he hates himself for making them. Bringing Cayrn to LifeA character like Cayrn needed a voice capable of balancing authority, vulnerability, humor, and quiet heartbreak. That's why we're incredibly excited to have Liam O'Brien bringing him to life.Known for portraying characters of immense emotional depth, Liam perfectly captures Cayrn's contradictions: the weary veteran hiding a deeply compassionate heart, the brilliant operative masking old scars with sarcasm, and the reluctant hero who keeps showing up even when he no longer believes he'll be thanked for it. Fun fact: when Cayrn was first created around a tabletop RPG campaign years ago, Liam O'Brien was already one of the inspirations behind the character. Life has a funny way of coming full circle. The character itself draws inspiration from some unforgettable figures. There's a touch of Berlin's charisma and effortless style, Athos' melancholy nobility, and Butcher's ruthless pragmatism. Together, they create someone who can be charming one moment, intimidating the next, and unexpectedly moving when his guard finally slips. Because beneath the black-ops exterior and the sardonic grin, Cayrn is still fighting for something. He's just not entirely sure what that is anymore. 🌊 Flow with us✨ Wishlist Fading Echo ("https://store.steampowered.com/app/2467880/Fading_Echo/?snr=1_2108_9__2107")And follow the adventure:YouTube ("https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=null%2F%2Fopenurl_external%2Fhttps%3A%2F%2Fsteamcommunity.com%2Flinkfilter%2F%3Fu%3Dhttp%253A%252F%252Fwww.youtube.com%252F%2540FadingEchoGame%253Fsub_confirmation%253D1%26snr%3D1_2108_9__2107") | TikTok ("https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=null%2F%2Fopenurl_external%2Fhttps%3A%2F%2Fsteamcommunity.com%2Flinkfilter%2F%3Fu%3Dhttps%253A%252F%252Fwww.tiktok.com%252F%2540fadingechogame%26snr%3D1_2108_9__2107") | Instagram ("https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=null%2F%2Fopenurl_external%2Fhttps%3A%2F%2Fsteamcommunity.com%2Flinkfilter%2F%3Fu%3Dhttps%253A%252F%252Fwww.instagram.com%252Ffadingechogame%252F%26snr%3D1_2108_9__2107") | Discord ("https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=null%2F%2Fopenurl_external%2Fhttps%3A%2F%2Fsteamcommunity.com%2Flinkfilter%2F%3Fu%3Dhttps%253A%252F%252Fdiscord.gg%252Ffadingechogame%26snr%3D1_2108_9__2107")

events.title: Ygdran Hollow: A Monument to Failure
events.author: Galathée
events.body: When people think about fantasy worlds, they often imagine ancient ruins swallowed by forests.Ygdran Hollow is the opposite. Once, this region was covered by oceans, thriving ecosystems, and some of the most advanced research facilities on Corel. Today, it is a vast desert dominated by an impossible structure: a colossal tree-like organism so large that it can be seen from miles away, its roots twisting through shattered foundations and long-abandoned laboratories. Its name is Ygdran, and it wasn't supposed to happen.Corel's Greatest Creation?Long before the events of Fading Echo, House Kelevra stood at the forefront of scientific and Ætheric research on Corel.Among their many projects was an ambitious experiment designed to address one of the world's greatest threats: corruption.The goal was simple in theory and nearly impossible in practice. Create a living organism capable of absorbing and processing corrupted Æther before it could spread further across the world.For a brief moment, it looked like they had succeeded… Then Ygdran kept growing, and growing, and growing… What was meant to be a solution became something else entirely. The Sea Beneath the SandOne of the most striking aspects of Ygdran Hollow is the contrast between what it is and what it used to be.Throughout the area, players will discover evidence that this desert was once covered by water. Giant shells lie stranded in the sand, research facilities stand half-buried beneath roots and rock, forgotten pathways hint at a thriving region that disappeared long before One's journey began. Ygdran didn't simply grow larger than expected, it consumed everything around it. Designed to absorb corrupted Æther, the organism instead drained vast amounts of healthy Æther from its surroundings, disrupting the delicate balance that sustained the region's ecosystems. Over time, the oceans receded, the land dried out, and entire settlements were swallowed beneath roots powerful enough to tear apart stone and steel alike. The desert itself is the scar left behind. One of the First Areas We DesignedYgdran Hollow holds a special place in the development of Fading Echo. It was one of the very first regions we started designing when the project was still taking shape. The image of a colossal tree rising from a dead sea immediately captured our imagination and helped define many of the themes that would later become central to the game. Ironically, it was also one of the last areas we fully completed. Over the years, the Hollow evolved alongside the rest of the project, growing from a striking visual concept into a location deeply connected to Corel's history, the legacy of House Kelevra, and the mysteries surrounding the corruption. In many ways, the area grew just as relentlessly as Ygdran itself.Thankfully, with considerably less collateral damage. More Than a LandscapeWhat makes Ygdran Hollow memorable isn't just its scale, it's the story hidden beneath the roots.Every ruined structure, every dried seabed, and every abandoned experiment tells the same tale: a world desperately trying to save itself and paying a terrible price for failure.As One explores the Hollow, she'll uncover pieces of that story and begin to understand a truth that echoes throughout Corel: sometimes the things we create to save the world are the very things that change it forever. 🌊 Flow with us✨ Wishlist Fading Echo events.title: Maddock Kelevra: the hero of his own story
events.author: Galathée
events.body: It's time to talk about the man behind the curtain: the architect, the manipulator, the voice whispering that perhaps freedom isn't worth the price it demands.His name is Maddock Kelevra, and he believes he can save reality itself. Who is Maddock?Before he became one of the leaders of the Paradox, Maddock was a Legend and, yes, a Kelevra (but we will not spoil further).A scholar, warrior, and master of Ætheric sciences. While others earned fame through daring exploits and impossible feats, Maddock built his reputation differently. He was known for his intellect, his strategic mind, and his relentless pursuit of understanding the forces that bind worlds together. Unlike many of his peers, he was never interested in becoming a hero. What fascinated him was the machinery of existence itself: the hidden laws governing reality, possibility, and fate.That pursuit eventually led him to a conclusion that would change everything. The Problem with Infinite PossibilityThe Echoverse exists because of the Æther, a force of endless creation, transformation, and possibility.Every choice creates new paths. Every possibility gives birth to new realities. Every reality, in turn, creates countless more possibilities.To most people, that sounds beautiful but to Maddock, it's terrifying. He sees the Æther's infinite potential not as a gift, but as a fundamental flaw: an endless chain reaction driving reality toward instability, fragmentation, and ultimately the Fade itself.Where others see freedom, Maddock sees chaos. Where others see opportunity, he sees a universe slowly tearing itself apart beneath the weight of its own possibilities.It was this belief that led him to the Paradox. The SingularityThe Paradox seeks a radical solution to reality's endless fragmentation: the creation of a Singularity. One reality.One outcome.One future. Its followers believe that by reducing the infinite branches spawned by the Æther into a single, unified path, they can finally bring an end to the cycle of collapse consuming the Echoverse.No more uncertainty. No more divergence. No more worlds fading into oblivion. It's a vision that has attracted followers across countless realities, and under Maddock's leadership, that vision has never been closer to becoming real on Corel. The MastermindMaddock doesn't lead through fear alone. Given the choice, he much prefers to lead through conviction.A gifted strategist and charismatic speaker, he possesses a rare ability to make impossible ideas sound reasonable and dangerous ideas sound necessary. He doesn't demand loyalty so much as inspire it, persuading others that they are choosing his path of their own free will. Perhaps that's what makes him so dangerous. Maddock doesn't see himself as a conqueror or a tyrant. He sees himself as the only person willing to make the difficult decisions others refuse to confront.From his perspective, every sacrifice, every betrayal, and every life lost along the way can be justified if it serves a greater purpose. At least, that's how Maddock sees it. The Opposite of OneIn many ways, Maddock stands as One's perfect opposite. Where One embraces the unknown, Maddock seeks to master it. Where she sees endless possibilities, he sees endless risks.Yet both are fighting for the future of the Echoverse, or at least for the future of Corel. Their conflict isn't simply a struggle between hero and villain. It's a clash between two fundamentally different visions of what the future should be, and neither is willing to abandon their beliefs. Bringing Maddock to LifeA character like Maddock needed a voice capable of balancing intelligence, charisma, authority, and menace.That's why we're thrilled to have the incredible Matt Mercer bringing him to life. Whether he's inspiring followers, delivering a carefully measured threat, or defending the Paradox's vision for the future, Matt captures the complexity that makes Maddock such a fascinating adversary.Maddock's personality was shaped by an unusual blend of influences. Part of his DNA comes from David Bowie’s enigmatic performance as Jareth in Labyrinth, part from the magnetic stage presence of Dave Gahan, the iconic frontman of Depeche Mode, and part from modern interpretations of Loki: characters capable of captivating a room long before revealing their true intentions. The result is a leader who can feel equal parts visionary, celebrity, and cult figure. Someone whose confidence is infectious, whose arguments are persuasive, and whose charm can make even the most dangerous ideas sound appealing.Because the most memorable villains aren't monsters, they're people who genuinely believe they're right. And yes, Matt also sings! Be sure to join our Discord ("https://discord.gg/fadingechogame") if you'd like to hear an exclusive track connected to the character. 😊 What's Next?Maddock believes the Echoverse can only survive if infinite possibility comes to an end.So we'll leave you with a question: if saving reality required sacrificing freedom, would you make the same choice?🌊 Flow with us✨ Wishlist Fading Echo ("https://store.steampowered.com/app/2467880/Fading_Echo/?snr=1_5_9_" style="pill")And follow the adventure:YouTube ("http://www.youtube.com/@FadingEchoGame?sub_confirmation=1") | TikTok ("https://www.tiktok.com/@fadingechogame") | Instagram ("https://www.instagram.com/fadingechogame/") | Discord ("https://discord.gg/fadingechogame")

events.title: Meet Bob: The Immortal, Highly Irritated Testing Dummy
events.author: Galathée
events.body:
Bob Wasn’t Supposed to ExistDuring an early internal review of some creature concepts from one of our devs, the whole team instantly fell in love with them. The boblets were almost too cute to fight.Someone joked: “It would be sad to kill those.”Then the idea escalated.What if one of them was unkillable? What if he always came back, no matter what you did?His name would be Bob.⚙️ The Bastion ProblemAround the same time, we were wrestling with a gameplay challenge.We needed a way to test perks and abilities inside the Bastion.Our early solutions involved dedicated rooms, basins, and structured testing environments. It was growing into a system of its own. Complex. Heavy. Starting to feel over-engineered.Then one night, during a narrative call with one of our writers, everything clicked.What if Bob wasn’t just a joke? What if he was the solution?Instead of building complex systems, Bob could become the in-world answer. A living, persistent character players could use to test perks directly.We pitched it back to the team.It immediately made sense.
From Design Tool to CharacterBob stopped being a design workaround.He became a presence.We leaned into his personality:[*]The Parisian attitude[/*][*]The slight arrogance[/*][*]The “I can’t die, and I’m annoyed about it” energy[/*]Little by little, he started taking more and more room in the game.And that’s when Bob truly began.📖 Bob in the EchoverseBob is classified as a Wonder, created by Vellum as part of an artistic experiment in shaping lifeforms with Aether.Originally designed to clean the Bastion and assist the Kelevra in transporting Aether out of Corel, Bob proved… too efficient.He began duplicating himself to make the work easier.That quickly spiraled.The population exploded. The boblets embedded themselves into Corel’s alien ecosystem, drawn instinctively to Aether and those who wield it.Vellum eventually removed Bob’s ability to clone.In the process, he accidentally made him immortal.This is Bob’s only true power.Immortality sounds impressive.Bob disagrees.🌀 Animation SpotlightOnce Bob became more than a system, his animation had to match his attitude.His body language leans into:[*]Exaggeration[/*][*]Defiance[/*][*]Mild existential frustration[/*]Even when he gets knocked down… he gets back up again.Every time.🎙 Giving Bob a VoiceWhen Bob evolved from design solution to character, we knew he needed a voice that could balance charm, theatrical irritation, and absurd immortality.That’s where Sam Riegel came in.His performance helped solidify Bob’s tone, pushing the Parisian attitude and bringing to life a character who technically cannot die… but very much complains about it.💬 Got questions? Wanna see more? Join us on Discord ("https://discord.gg/fadingechogame") to share your thoughts & feedback!— The Fading Echo Team🌊 Flow with us✨ Wishlist Fading EchoSteam ("https://store.steampowered.com/app/2467880/Fading_Echo/") | Epic Games Store ("https://store.epicgames.com/p/fading-echo-029d57") | PlayStation Store ("https://store.playstation.com/concept/10014310") | Xbox Store ("https://www.xbox.com/games/store/Fading-Echo/9N0MHMP8Z20G")And follow the adventure:YouTube ("https://www.youtube.com/@FadingEchoGame?sub_confirmation=1") | TikTok ("https://www.tiktok.com/@fadingechogame") | Instagram ("https://www.instagram.com/fadingechogame/")

events.title: We Built “Motion Comics” Instead of Cutscenes, Here’s Why
events.author: Galathée
events.body:
Cutscenes are tricky, especially for an indie, gameplay-first studio like us.We knew early on that we wanted strong narrative moments in Fading Echo. But we also knew we didn’t want to constantly pull players out of the game. So instead of going for traditional cinematic cutscenes, we chose a different path.Here’s how and why.Our Graphic Novel DNA Visually, Fading Echo lives somewhere between manga, US comics… and European graphic novels.That mix is intentional. These influences shaped us growing up, and we wanted the game to carry a distinctly European comics flag. What we love about European graphic novels is how they handle time and framing. They often rely less on fluid animation and more on strong compositions, carefully chosen angles, and moments where a single image does most of the storytelling. That approach heavily influenced our cutscenes. Rather than fully animated sequences, we use:[*]mostly static scenes[/*][*]camera movement inside the frame[/*][*]lighting, VFX, and sound to suggest motion and intensity[/*]
It’s not about copying comics panel by panel, but about borrowing their visual language and adapting it to a game, in the same spirit you might find in Batman: Arkham Asylum or certain TV series intros.Motion comics is an entire genre in its own and a strong influence for us as it perfectly captures one of Fading Echo game design pillars around movement and fluidity against rigidity.Constraints as a Creative ToolCutscenes are expensive. There’s no way around it.For a small team focused on gameplay systems, fully animated cinematics just weren’t realistic. Forcing them would have meant sacrificing other parts of the game, and that wasn’t an option.So we asked ourselves a simple question:"How do we make this feel intentional, not compromised?"This approach allowed us to:[*]keep production costs under control[/*][*]iterate faster[/*][*]stay visually consistent[/*][*]and (hopefully) create something that doesn’t look like the usual indie cutscene[/*]What started as a limitation slowly turned into a style we genuinely liked and wanted to push further.Cutscenes as Narrative AnchorsWe don’t want Fading Echo to stop you every few minutes to explain itself.Movement is core to the game, so cutscenes are used sparingly and with purpose:[*]more present at the beginning to set the stage[/*][*]stronger at the end to support the epic moments[/*][*]and at key milestones, like when you free an island[/*] They act as narrative anchors, not constant interruptions, moments that punctuate progression rather than breaking momentum.Breaking the Rules With Werlen MeyerA big part of this came from our collaboration with our friends at Werlen Meyer.We chose them not only because they’re incredibly talented, but also because they had never worked on in-game cutscenes before. No habits. No “this is how it’s usually done”.Together, we experimented a lot:[*]how far we could push still images[/*][*]how much emotion sound and lighting could carry[/*][*]how camera movement alone could suggest action[/*]That shared willingness to break things and occasionally get things wrong was key to finding the final style.This cutscene approach isn’t about reinventing storytelling. It’s just us trying to tell our story in a way that fits Fading Echo, our constraints, and our tastes.💬Got questions? Wanna see more? Join us on Discord ("https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fdiscord.gg%2Ffadingechogame") to share your thoughts & feedbacks!- The Fading Echo Team🌊 Flow with us✨ Wishlist Fading EchoSteam ("https://store.steampowered.com/app/2467880/Fading_Echo/?snr=1_5_9_") | Epic Games Store ("https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fstore.epicgames.com%2Fp%2Ffading-echo-029d57") | PlayStation Store ("https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fstore.playstation.com%2Fconcept%2F10014310") | Xbox Store ("https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.xbox.com%2Fgames%2Fstore%2FFading-Echo%2F9N0MHMP8Z20G")And follow the adventure:YouTube ("https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.youtube.com%2F%40FadingEchoGame%3Fsub_confirmation%3D1") | TikTok ("https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.tiktok.com%2F%40fadingechogame") | Instagram ("https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.instagram.com%2Ffadingechogame%2F")

events.author: Galathée
events.body:
Hey Legends,If you played Fading Echo back in alpha: welcome home. 💧 Same core idea (save the world by aggressively splashing things). New slice of the game. More stuff to melt.👉  Play the demo on Steam ("https://store.steampowered.com/app/4151000/Fading_Echo_Demo/")WELCOME (BACK) TO THE VOLCANO SOURCE 🌋We’re turning up the heat with a demo set in the first Volcano Source.Deep in the heart of an ancient forge, One is chasing the first Ætheric source through the remains of a long-forgotten civilization.You might uncover something about your new powers.You might just have a really good time turning problems into puddles. Both outcomes are valid.REACT. IMPROVISE. SURVIVE. 💧Water, lava, toxic waste, if it flows, it fights.Use surrounding fluids to burn, solidify, and weaken enemies.Chain reactions into elemental combos.Finish it up with stylish hand-to-hand attacks. Creativity isn’t a bonus. It’s the plan.THEY’RE NOT JUST NPCs, THEY’RE FAMILY 👩‍👧‍👦Meet: [*]Rahne, your mother (yes, really). [/*][*]Vellum, your aetheric spiritual guide (also really).[/*]Trusted sidekicks for your extremely normal mission to save your homeworld from impending destruction. You know. The usual.WE NEED YOUR BRAIN (FEEDBACK) 🧠If you play, we’d especially love thoughts on: [*]Combat feel + readability of elemental reactions[/*][*]Controls and pacing through the Volcano Source[/*][*]Clarity of puzzles/objectives[/*][*]Performance/bugs (anything weird is gold)[/*]KNOW ISSUES ⚠️🎮 Gameplay / Controls[*]Controller recommended. Keyboard and input rebinding are available.[/*][*]Skip prompt stays on screen. If you skip a cutscene, the “skip” prompt may remain visible every time you dash.[/*][*]Possible softlock in the Bastion after skipping cutscenes.

Workaround: If it happens, the only workaround is to start a new save.

events.title: Devlog #11 – The One Where We Make A Game – Pt.3
events.author: Kragaan_NT
events.body: The One Where The Team Nails ProductionPreviously on the New Tales devblog...So now that we’ve covered the prototype and pre-production, it’s time to talk Production!Okay so now we know what we want to do, so let’s do it? Not necessarily that simple. We need to come up with a comprehensive roadmap that allows us to see how much time it should take to make our game, with the correct order of events. Perhaps not super exciting to most, but shoutout to my fellow excel lovers!How much will the game cost?Do we need to hire more people? Will we need to hire external contractors?When do we need them to join?When can we expect the game to ship?What is the best marketing strategy?Once we’ve tried to predict the answers to these questions, we can start *really* making a game. Let’s go!Assessing the costThis process is essential to make sure that we have a chance to make a second game (Fading Echo: Two??). It’s not as simple as calculating everyone’s salaries; we have to factor in the cost of: renting an office, electricity bills, licenses (Maya, Photoshop etc), croissant breakfasts, team building etc.Hiring Internally and ExternallyWhen building the studio, we knew our best chance of success was to focus on a few key elements and build a great team in-house, and then rely on contractors who can join us for select periods of time.As an example, we couldn’t afford to build both an Environment Art team, as well as a Character Art team. As our game is SO focused on the different realities, we decided it made more sense to go for the first option. That meant we found some incredibly talented artists that could help us take the characters from concept to reality, without adding fulltime headcount.This is just one example, but it also applies to Narrative, Audio (Sounds + Music), VFX and more!Once we figured out what support we needed, we also decide when it best makes sense for them to join us. For example, it’s much easier to make the music of the realities once we have some visual references in-game, so we knew we wanted to bring in our composer a little bit later. On the other hand, we needed a writer very early on, to help ensure the game we were building made sense.Ship it!At the end of the day, we need to ensure we are staying a-float. I’m not shore I know what to say about this one? We just need to make ship happen. Okay, okay sorry.In order to market the game, we need to know when is a good time to release it. This requires not only looking at how much time we think it will take to make the game, but also what the market looks like at the time. For example, when is GTA VI coming out? Let’s avoid that porthole window!Capturing the Market!One does not simply … make great games without marketing. While we refine exactly what the game will be, this is where we figure out who are target demographic is *hint* It might be you .We do many workshops to assess what aspects of the game we think are the most important and which kind of players best match so we can begin to create our social media pages and marketing strategy, to ensure we are able to share our game with the people who will enjoy it most.Rumour has it that the Producer who wrote this blog originally wrote a 57 page book but it was deemed “too much information”, so don’t hesitate if you have more questions, drop them in the comments, as I’m sure she would be willing to join your “COLOUR CODING IS LYF3” club 🙂– The Emeteria Team

events.title: 🎁 The Closed Alpha Returns — Your Early December Gift Has Arrived!
events.author: Kragaan_NT
events.body: Ho ho ho, Legends! 🎅The Maze has opened once again — and this time, it’s delivering an early holiday surprise.That’s right: the Fading Echo Closed Alpha is officially back online starting today, and we couldn’t be happier to invite you in for another round of fluid-bending chaos, exploration, and discoveries.Whether you played during the first playtest or you’ve just joined the community, consider this your December gift from the Echoverse. The world has grown, the systems have evolved, and much more...Let’s unwrap what’s new. 💧🎁What’s New Since the First Playtest?A lot has changed since you last stepped into the Echoverse. For this December reopening, we’ve packed the Closed Alpha with new content, fresh visuals, smoother combat, and system reworks designed to make the experience more dynamic, readable, and surprising. Here are the biggest highlights:🌋 A World That Feels AliveThe Volcano is now fully dressed, the Bastion has brand-new visuals inside and out, and the Collapse Dimension has evolved with strange cables, jellyfish, and glitchy anomalies. The world is richer, clearer, and more atmospheric than ever.⚔️ Sharper, Faster, Better CombatOne’s kit feels snappier — a faster Combat Dash, stronger Cannonball, improved push attack, and smarter, more expressive enemies make every fight more reactive and satisfying.🎥 3D Cutscenes & Clearer StorytellingCinematic moments now play out in 3D, although they are still very much work-in-progress. Some dialogues and subtitles have also been refined to keep the experience cleaner and more immersive.🌬️ Systemic Upgrades EverywhereSteam Form has been reworked for more freedom and smoother transitions, elemental absorption speeds are adjusted, and the whole systemic sandbox feels more responsive.🔊 Better Sounds, Better FeedbackUpdated music, clearer audio cues, and new SFX make every action — from landing a crit to buying a perk — feel more alive.🧰 Quality-of-Life BoostsCamera sensitivity options, improved KB/M controls, faster performance, perk preview videos, and a cleaner HUD all help the game feel smoother and easier to read.⚠️ Known Issues (Important!)This is still an Alpha build — here are the key things to keep in mind:🚪 Portal CrashesCrashes may occur during transitions. Avoid traveling in Water Form through portals where possible.🌋 Systemic Reaction CrashesHeavy elemental reactions (lava, waste, water everywhere) can occasionally cause crashes. Restarting usually resolves it.💾 Save Loss After CrashProgress may occasionally be lost after a crash. When you reload your save:[*]If One has Blue hair → everything is normal[/*][*]If One has Brown hair → please restart the game (sometimes requires a few tries)[/*]Ready to Jump Back In?The Closed Alpha is available right now on Steam.If you joined the first playtest via Steam, simply update the game in your Library and you’re good to go.New explorer? Just register directly on the Steam store page ("https://store.steampowered.com/app/2467880/Fading_Echo/") to get instant access to the playtest.💬 And don’t forget to join us on Discord ("https://discord.gg/fadingechogame") to share your thoughts & feedbacks!- The Fading Echo Team🌊 Flow with us✨ Wishlist Fading EchoSteam ("https://store.steampowered.com/app/2467880/Fading_Echo/") | Epic Games Store ("https://store.epicgames.com/p/fading-echo-029d57") | PlayStation Store ("https://store.playstation.com/concept/10014310") | Xbox Store ("https://www.xbox.com/games/store/Fading-Echo/9N0MHMP8Z20G")And follow the adventure:YouTube ("http://www.youtube.com/@FadingEchoGame?sub_confirmation=1") | TikTok ("https://www.tiktok.com/@fadingechogame") | Instagram ("https://www.instagram.com/fadingechogame/")

events.title: Devlog #10 - The One Where We Make A Game – Pt.2
events.author: Kragaan_NT
events.body: The One Where The Team Starts Pre-ProductionJust like building a car or a house (I assume…) it’s important to ensure there is a good foundation before starting production. Different industries use different names for this, but within games we call this Pre-Production.An important component of a successful pre-production is to know to answer questions without finishing features. It’s not about having things perfect, instead about ensuring that we know roughly how long something will eventually take and what components we need to consider ahead of time.For us, that was six weeks where we answered a lot of questions like:Which enemies will we need, and how many?What will the realities look like and how do we make them within our budget?How versatile is One, can she deliver all the emotions of the storyline?And the million dollar question (seriously, it’s been expensive) – how will we render One’s hair?Enemy TypesDuring pre-production, we focus on how the enemies will work more than how they would look. We start with core mechanics and ensure they are working and fun and only then can the concepts begin. Here is an example of the original pitch of the Ranged enemy. We discussed which attacks could be fun and how they could connect to elements.Art PipelineKnowing that we wanted to have multiple realities meant we had to be very smart on how we built assets. We knew we couldn’t afford to make three completely unique realities without reusing content. We started with really simple tests like changing the colours of a rock to see if it could look different enough.Not only was this an efficient way to create multiple items from one, it also helped us figure out how we would represent that the game has different realities, as opposed to alternative worlds.In this image, you can see that a test of swapping out a few assets (highlighted in orange) and a different arrangement of coloured rocks look similar enough, but still with changes in the aesthetics and feeling of the space.Tone + EmotionDuring this time we were working on figuring out our tone and how our characters would show emotions. We always loved the over-the-top reactions used in many anime and manga, so we tested how extreme One’s face could go without looking broken.We wanted One to be able to be very serious and intense but also very silly and comical so we were very pleased with these results.Fluid RenderingWe knew water (and other elements) were crucial to our game, so we spent a lot of time doing Research and Development of various solutions to see what would make the most sense for us. Comprehensively going through different pre-made solutions as well as prototyping our own solutions.Investigations included tools like FluidNinja Live and VFX, Niagara Fluids as well as in-house options like materials with ripples or baked mesh animations.Island ThemingThis was a really interesting and complex problem to solve, figuring out what the themes of the islands would be. We knew we wanted a semi-linear experience where the player could choose any direction and should have a unique feeling. We have to confirm things like:Does each island make sense within the Bible/history of Fading Echo?Could we explain their stories in narrative and environmentally storytelling, without being too complex?Were they unique enough from each other but not so different we couldn’t re-use content between them?There was A LOT of back and forth here and many loops of validation – and still quite a few changes since this document was made back in April 2024.Taking the time to discuss the HOW, WHEN and arguably most importantly, the WHY, ensured we could start the Production phase of the game in the most efficient and exciting way… but more on that next week 😉.The Emeteria Team🌊 Flow with us✨ Wishlist Fading EchoSteam ("steam://openurl/https://store.steampowered.com/app/2467880/Fading_Echo/?snr=___") | Epic Games Store ("steam://openurl_external/https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fstore.epicgames.com%2Fp%2Ffading-echo-029d57") | PlayStation Store ("steam://openurl_external/https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fstore.playstation.com%2Fconcept%2F10014310") | Xbox Store ("steam://openurl_external/https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.xbox.com%2Fgames%2Fstore%2FFading-Echo%2F9N0MHMP8Z20G")💬 Join the Echoverse on Discord ("steam://openurl_external/https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fdiscord.gg%2Ffadingechogame")And follow the adventure:YouTube ("steam://openurl_external/https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.youtube.com%2F%40FadingEchoGame%3Fsub_confirmation%3D1") | TikTok ("steam://openurl_external/https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.tiktok.com%2F%40fadingechogame") | Instagram ("steam://openurl_external/https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.instagram.com%2Ffadingechogame%2F")
